mapper.select: select * from BOARD_COMMENT where BOARD_ID = #{boardId} order by COALESCE(PARENT_ID, COMMENT_ID), COMMENT_ID
mapper.insert: insert into BOARD_COMMENT(BOARD_ID, CONTENT, WRITER, PASSWORD, PARENT_ID) values(#{boardId}, #{content}, #{writer}, #{password}, #{parentId})
mapper.update: update BOARD_COMMENT set CONTENT = #{content}, PASSWORD = #{password}, MODIFIED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where COMMENT_ID = #{commentId}
update BOARD_COMMENT set IS_DELETED = TRUE, CONTENT = '' WHERE COMMENT_ID = #{commentId}
